# Eat Well

> Playable web demo of Eat Well, a dietary restaurant finder built for the Pimoroni Tufty 2350 badge (SELECT badge contest entry). Browse 462 curated vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, kosher, and halal restaurants across 12 US cities; every listing shows a scannable MapQuest QR code. Menus and dietary practices change — verify directly with the restaurant. Listings researched October 2026.

## Demo

- [Play the demo](https://eat-well-demo.view.fast/): full badge UI emulation in the browser — animated pixel-art splash, city picker, diet filters, results, detail screens with QR codes, credits page. Keyboard and on-screen badge buttons.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Mike-Demo/eat-well): MIT-licensed badge app, pixel-art pipeline, restaurant dataset, and research notes.

## Coverage

- Cities: San Francisco, Twin Cities (Minneapolis–Saint Paul), Chicago, New York, Los Angeles, Houston, Phoenix, Philadelphia, San Antonio, San Diego, Dallas, San Jose.
- Diets: vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, kosher, halal. At least 10 matches per diet per city where honest supply permits; San Francisco and San Jose have fewer than 10 verified kosher options and the app says so rather than inventing listings.
- "Near me" uses IP geolocation (ipwho.is) to pick the closest covered city.

## Credits

- Built by [Mike Demopoulos](https://mikedemo.com) for the SELECT badge contest.
- Badge framework: [Badgeware](https://github.com/pimoroni/tufty2350) (Pimoroni Tufty 2350, MIT).
- Pixel art: Adobe Firefly. Map data and place listings: MapQuest. QR encoding: Segno (BSD-3-Clause).
